assetGroups.title: App icon source artwork
acceptance: Approved product-owned source artwork is supplied before icon generation.
Artwork reviewer or owner is named before the asset pass.
Light, Dark, and Tinted appearance support is explicitly accepted or deferred.
The icon source is not a generated analyzer screenshot or unsupported brand claim.

assetGroups.title: App icon asset catalog generation
acceptance: Generated app icon renditions are derived from approved source artwork.
The Xcode project sets ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_APPICON_NAME only in a dedicated asset pass.
The existing AccentColor asset remains valid after icon generation.
Generated icon files are reviewed before they are committed.

assetGroups.title: Launch asset decision
acceptance: The release owner decides whether to use default SwiftUI launch behavior or a product-owned launch asset.
Any launch asset is derived from approved product artwork, not screenshots or analyzer output.
The decision is validated on iPhone, iPad, and macOS before release packaging.

assetGroups.title: App Store screenshot policy
acceptance: Screenshots are captured from real AMG Decoder app UI.
The screenshot set covers iPhone, iPad, and macOS if those platforms are included in distribution.
The screenshot set includes reviewed Light and Dark appearance decisions.
Visible analyzer results preserve the descriptive-only boundary and show source attribution where applicable.
No screenshot text implies authentication, model identity, value, ownership, warranty eligibility, or unsupported serial coverage.
